title: Princess Y85
highlights: Teak decks and hi-lo bathing platform
description:
An exceptional 2021 Princess Y85 with only 240 hours, combining refined British craftsmanship with impressive performance and volume. Her elegant, light-filled interior is finished to a high standard, complemented by expansive exterior spaces.

Twin MAN V12 engines, comprehensive navigation and bow and stern thrusters make her effortless to handle. Features include a generous flybridge, teak decks, a hi-lo bathing platform and a premium entertainment package. She is lying in Essex, United Kingdom.
